gl28c.notes: EN 14080:2013 combined glued laminated timber, class GL28c. Characteristic density rho_k = 390 kg/m3; the card's density is rho_mean = 420 kg/m3. Strengths are 5%-fractile characteristic values along the grain (bending f_m,g,k, compression f_c,0,g,k, tension f_t,0,g,k). lvl.notes: Generic all-parallel-veneer LVL at the level ETAs for products such as Kerto-S declare. mdf.notes: The numbers are the STANDARD'S MINIMA for general-purpose MDF in dry conditions at 12-19 mm, not typicals — a real board usually beats them, and thinner boards are held to higher minima. MDF is isotropic in the panel plane (no grain), which is why it machines so cleanly, but it has almost no edge screw-holding and swells irreversibly when wet. No tensile or compressive value is carried: EN 622-5 specifies bending and internal bond (>= 0.6 MPa), not in-plane strength.
